method: Generates a .path unit and a same-base Type=oneshot .service unit, linked explicitly with Unit=. Implements the systemd.path conditions PathExists, PathExistsGlob, PathChanged, PathModified and DirectoryNotEmpty, preserving multiple watched paths as separate directives. Watched and working paths use C-style \x20 and \x22 escapes for spaces and quotes, while executable arguments use double-quoted ExecStart syntax; literal percent signs are doubled, and ExecStart also doubles dollar signs. Accepts 1–32 unique absolute watched paths and 1–256 non-empty argument lines; rejects parent components, backslashes, control characters, relative executables and unsupported account names. Optional MakeDirectory and DirectoryMode support systemd directory creation, except with PathExists where MakeDirectory is ignored by systemd and therefore rejected here. TriggerLimitIntervalSec and TriggerLimitBurst are emitted explicitly (defaults 2s and 200; either may be 0), requiring systemd 250+. The companion service deliberately has no Restart or [Install] section; only the path unit may include WantedBy=multi-user.target. The tool does not inspect the host or execute commands. As documented by systemd, path activation uses inotify and cannot observe changes made by other machines on remote NFS filesystems; existing PathExists/DirectoryNotEmpty conditions trigger immediately, while change conditions do not retroactively trigger.
